### Root source-integration acceptance — exact head618ad8f9

The recovered production bytes remain exact; existing response/errors, object-import defaults, withSession and all other store methods are preserved. Independent `mac_recovery` receiving accepts the same three source bodies, the new test and the single test-command append with no remaining source concern. This is a source decision under the standing estate mandate.

At this merge turn, all seven source-head check-runs are completed/success. The hosted checkout's received tree is `8457386cf41c5530b39dec1fa6be127dfc430d01`. A fresh isolated native Git graph fetch independently ran `git merge-base --is-ancestor 8d74413d7dbc3caf1745779c92d56b6eb7feea42 618ad8f9702a39d23965e0ff68065822629bb9ba` with exit0, then confirmed exact head/tree/sole parent. Native receipt SHA256: `05fd7930e3996f5b4b6aaedc1168f5f2abf384b687cc00b6a614ad4a206fafb5`.

The live duplicate check read every changed-file list for all nine open PRs and reconfirmed the same heads in this mutation turn. PR116's withSession change is disjoint from this client's raw-body change; its later owner composition must preserve both test arguments and its own prebuild/dependency work. PR104's separate package-test append remains separately owned. Current PR reviews and comments contain no blocking dissent.

The PR has been marked ready for this bounded source integration. This supersedes the initial draft hold recorded in the immutable source packet. The original Mac checkpoint-browser result remains **unknown** and is not being rerun or counted as a pass. No installed package, restored native career, runtime adoption or production benefit is claimed by the merge. Existing package/browser receivers retain that boundary.

Root will use the normal expected-head merge and verify the actual resulting parent/tree and every unrelated incoming file.
